lines.spoken: The man in red smiles up at you from the front page.
lines.caption: smiles up **at you**

lines.spoken: You pick it up. The paper is soft and yellow, like it's been lying there for years.
lines.caption: soft and **yellow**

lines.spoken: The date under the headline: March third, nineteen eighty seven.
You look down the car. Every newspaper has the same date.
lines.caption: the **same date**

lines.spoken: June doesn't look up from her knitting. "Put it down, sweetheart."
lines.caption: **put it down**

lines.spoken: "Where did he go?" you ask.
lines.caption: **where** did he go

lines.spoken: June's needles stop. Her eyes go to the door at the end of the car.
lines.caption: her **eyes** go to the door

lines.spoken: Through its little window, the last car is dark. One handle swings back and forth.
lines.caption: one handle **swings**

lines.spoken: "He's not in there," June says. "Not anymore."
lines.caption: **not anymore**

lines.spoken: Then, from the last car, a phone starts ringing.
lines.caption: a phone **starts ringing**

lines.spoken: His ringtone. It rings and rings. Nobody turns a page.
lines.caption: **nobody** turns a page

lines.spoken: Without meaning to, you start to stand.
lines.caption: you start to **stand**

lines.spoken: June's hand clamps onto your knee. "Never the last car. Never."
lines.caption: **never** the last car

lines.spoken: The ringing stops.
lines.caption: the ringing **stops**

lines.spoken: Above you, the lights flicker.
lines.caption: the lights **flicker**

lines.spoken: June squeezes your hand. "Eyes shut, sweetheart. Now."
lines.caption: **eyes shut**

lines.spoken: The lights go out. You squeeze your eyes shut.
lines.caption: **lights go out**

lines.spoken: In the dark, only the clack of the tracks.
lines.caption: the **clack** of the tracks

lines.spoken: Then, from the end of the car: click.
lines.caption: **click**

lines.spoken: Click. Closer.
lines.caption: **closer**

lines.spoken: Click. Right beside your ear.
lines.caption: beside **your ear**

lines.spoken: You can feel someone bending over you, waiting for you to look.
lines.caption: **waiting** for you to look

lines.spoken: You don't look.
lines.caption: you **don't** look

lines.spoken: The doors chime.
lines.caption: the doors **chime**

lines.spoken: The lights are back. June lets out a long breath. "Good. That was good."
lines.caption: **that was good**

lines.spoken: Then you notice the passengers.
lines.caption: the **passengers**

lines.spoken: For the first time, every one of them has turned a page.
lines.caption: every one has **turned a page**

lines.spoken: In your pocket, your phone buzzes.
lines.caption: your phone **buzzes**

lines.spoken: Still no signal. But someone is calling.
lines.caption: **no signal**

lines.spoken: It's your mom.
lines.caption: it's **your mom**

lines.spoken: June goes very still. "Don't, sweetheart."
lines.caption: **don't**

lines.spoken: But it's your mom. Your thumb is already on the green button.
lines.caption: already on **the green button**

lines.spoken: "Mom?"
lines.caption: **Mom?**

lines.spoken: Nothing. Then, very softly, in her voice, it says your name.
lines.caption: it says **your name**

lines.spoken: "I'm waiting at the next stop. Get off the train."
lines.caption: get off **the train**
